initialPrompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / identity-preserve.
Asset type: four decorative stage illustrations for a child-friendly math game, delivered as ONE 2-by-2 contact sheet.
Input image 1 is the identity and style reference. Preserve the EXACT same child and the EXACT same pet from this reference in every panel. These are new poses/actions of those characters, not new characters.
Character and pet invariants: The exact bob-haired girl from the reference: dark brown chin-length bob with bangs, warm brown eyes and round cheerful face; coral short-sleeve shirt, teal gardening apron with floral pocket, blue jeans, pale gray sneakers and white gardening gloves. The exact brown striped tabby kitten with white face, chest and paws.
Theme objects: a compact rectangular terracotta brick flower garden bed with pink, yellow and white flowers, teal watering can and small trowel.
Style/medium: richly detailed, cheerful hand-drawn colored-pencil illustration matching the reference, soft warm shading, visible pencil strokes, expressive friendly faces. Retain the reference palette and clothing colors.
Composition: one high-resolution wide 3:2 image, preferably 3072 x 2048, divided into a perfectly aligned invisible 2x2 grid of FOUR equal-size landscape cells. Each cell is an entirely separate complete scene. Every child, pet, prop and object must be wholly inside its own cell with generous clear transparent margins on every side, including the central vertical and horizontal gutters. Allow at least 8% empty transparent margin inside each cell; nothing may touch or cross cell boundaries. Compact clear silhouettes and readable actions when a single scene displays only 250px wide. The same child and pet appear once per cell. Simplify props as needed to ensure all are contained.
Stage positions:
Top-left: The girl studies an open blank instruction booklet beside the rectangular garden bed, with the same tabby kitten looking on.
Top-right: The girl thoughtfully holds a pencil above blank paper on a small clipboard while considering the garden layout; small garden bed beside her and the same tabby kitten nearby.
Bottom-left: The girl kneels and gently adjusts a flower or garden brick with the trowel beside her; the same tabby kitten watches.
Bottom-right: The girl smiles and raises one hand in a joyful celebration beside the completed rectangular flower garden, with the same tabby kitten playfully beside her.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the illustrated subjects and tiny local object shadows. No white paper background, no colored rectangle, no room, no sky, no full scenery, no opaque texture behind the figures. Pencil texture belongs only within the characters and objects.
Constraints: NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO equations, NO labels, NO speech bubbles, NO captions, NO panel borders or visible grid, NO watermarks. Book/clipboard pages are blank except optional faint non-symbolic pencil gesture. Decorative illustrations only, not precise mathematical diagrams. No duplicated or extra people or pets, no cut-off limbs, no objects connecting cells. Preserve all four distinct requested actions.
